description: Creates/deletes an issue in a Taiga Project Management Platform (https://taiga.io).

parameters.name: attachment
parameters.description: Path to a file to be attached to the issue.

parameters.name: attachment_description
parameters.description: A string describing the file to be attached to the issue. Default: ""

parameters.name: issue_type
parameters.description: The issue type. Must exist previously.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: The issue priority. Must exist previously. Default: "Normal"

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Name of the project containing the issue. Must exist previously.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: The issue severity. Must exist previously. Default: "Normal"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the issue should be present or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The issue status. Must exist previously. Default: "New"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A lists of tags to be assigned to the issue. Default: []

parameters.name: taiga_host
parameters.description: The hostname of the Taiga instance. Default: "https://api.taiga.io"

examples:
- name: Create an issue in the my hosted Taiga environment and attach an error log
  community.general.taiga_issue:
    taiga_host: https://mytaigahost.example.com
    project: myproject
    subject: An error has been found
    issue_type: Bug
    priority: High
    status: New
    severity: Important
    description: An error has been found. Please check the attached error log for details.
    attachment: /path/to/error.log
    attachment_description: Error log file
    tags:
      - Error
      - Needs manual check
    state: present

- name: Deletes the previously created issue
  community.general.taiga_issue:
    taiga_host: https://mytaigahost.example.com
    project: myproject
    subject: An error has been found
    issue_type: Bug
    state: absent
